description: Create a new knowledge base for a location. Max 15 per location. This becomes the user's personal AI trained on their business data.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

description.description: Description of what this knowledge base contains

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name.description: Name of the knowledge base (e.g., 'Company FAQ', 'Product Catalog', 'Sales Playbook')

name: crm_create_knowledge_base
